acceptedSourceBoundaries.p207MutationScope: module digest, fixture digest, four existing changed-Go value digests plus map digest, and four workflow pins

blockingFinding.evidence: reserve_output(value) checks only nonexistence and parent existence, then os.mkdir(out). It receives no protected roots and has no is_relative_to containment rejection.
blockingFinding.counterexample: A new --out path beneath the exact formal repository or its .git/common directory is accepted. Generation then writes .private-work, afterimages, patch, and manifest there. HEAD/tree and shared refs/index/config checks still pass because they do not cover working-tree untracked files or arbitrary git-common children.
blockingFinding.impact: The tool can report success while modifying the formal repository/worktree, contradicting the no-formal-mutation safety boundary. SAFE-USAGE text does not fail closed.
minimumRevision: Resolve formal top, candidate top, formal git-common dir, and candidate git-common dir before output reservation.
Pass these protected roots into reserve_output and reject when the resolved target is equal to or is_relative_to any protected root before os.mkdir.
Retain the existing nonexistent-target and non-symlink-parent checks.
Add negative tests for formal descendant, candidate descendant, and git-common descendant; assert that none is created.
Add a positive test for a new external sibling output and retain failure-output preservation.
